subject: general
question: In a certain code language if HIMSELF is written as FKKUCND, then how will OUTDOOR be written in the same code language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

HIMSELF is written as FKKUCND

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82bfc988fd87e05dc63976a6ad86f465597d803d591d5099bb8bedecd8dae420.png] 

Similarly,

'**OUTDOOR**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b73ddb42e2a7c4d19476d10eebd1578c20f9cdc11f964c2361a4a6162187472.png] 

Hence, 'OUTDOOR' is coded as "**MWRFMQP**".
